ticket.title: outfeed gate: run the whole Tier 3 matrix as one P1 command
ticket.description: Split out of GB-164 as its own ticket and placed at the very front of the queue. One command that runs the Tier 3 matrix in order - cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo nextest run --workspace, miter contracts, outfeed lockfiles, chalkline docs check --workspace - with per-step pass/fail and a non-zero exit on any failure. It is also the capture hook GB-165 needs: a green gate is the natural moment to extract base..head functions and emit traces. Motivation is first-hand - two commits today slipped on hand-assembled gates, one leaving Cargo.lock unstaged because git add -A crates did not cover it, and one leaving a #[cfg(test)] attribute attached to the wrong module.

verification_receipt.summary: Closed on outfeed main at abe070c, developed on feat/outfeed-gate with the lease taken before any edit. outfeed gate runs six steps in release-checklist order - fmt, clippy, tests via nextest, miter contracts, the native lockfile audit and chalkline docs check - reporting one line per step and failing non-zero at the first failure. The lockfile step calls the core audit directly so a gate run cannot recurse into itself. Built as gate/mod.rs (matrix and run) plus gate/execute.rs (spawning and reporting) to stay inside the size law, with run_gate_steps taking an explicit step list so the matrix is testable without invoking cargo; six tests cover order, skip semantics, a missing binary, a failing command, report rendering and the native lockfile step. Verified live: the first run caught an unused import this change introduced, the second failed on genuine disk pressure (2.84 GB free vs 3.73 GB required) rather than on code, and after reclaiming 4.3 GB and documenting GateReport in SPEC.md the run is 4 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped. Known limitation recorded: the contracts step needs miter index to have run, and the lockfiles step reports a skip when the target directory holds no member repositories. Gates: fmt clean, clippy clean, nextest 79/79, docs 9 present 0 missing 0 drifted.
